lifecycle.gateTitle: Admit after the scheme matures — enters the dev side

scheduleForm.title: Schedule: create the dev pool placeholder
scheduleForm.hint: Scheduling is embodied by a pool placeholder — pools consume capacity exactly like named assignments; naming is how they get satisfied.

reopenForm.title: Reopen design (scheme regression)
reopenForm.hint: Pause keeps rows but exits capacity math; release deletes dev-side rows; number kept.

quick.dateAutoHint: Dates default to the project aspiration window; scheduling creates a pool placeholder that consumes capacity like named staffing.

warnings.NO_DEV_DEMAND: Scheduled / in iteration but no dev pool or named dev assignment — capacity not locked
warnings.NO_LOC_ESTIMATE: Scheduled / in iteration but no LOC estimation — dev demand unknown
warnings.NO_DESIGN_ESTIMATE: Designing but no rough design estimate recorded
warnings.DESIGN_NOT_BACKFILLED: Past design but actual design effort never backfilled — rough estimates cannot calibrate
warnings.DELIVERED_NOT_BACKFILLED: Delivered but actuals never backfilled — deviation cannot be tracked
warnings.NO_ITERATION_NUMBER: In iteration but the SR/AR number is missing — cannot cross-check with the external system
warnings.ITER_OVER_DEADLINE: Iteration window ends after the deadline
warnings.DEV_NO_MDE: Primary dev assigned but no MDE pairing
warnings.ASSIGN_AFTER_DELIVERY: Primary dev window ends after the iteration window
warnings.SE_WONT_MAKE_IT: SE effort exceeds available capacity before iteration start
